key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AC9C
name: fill_record_fields_within_limit
description: Calls an indirect routine several times to obtain slot offsets, then stores fields from an eight-byte table record into those slots. It recurses for the next record only while the running total stays under a fixed bound.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AE0C
name: initialise_slot_from_template
description: If the slot already has state 2, it first calls a library function on it. It then copies a 14-long template into the slot, stores two coordinates shifted left by nine bits, and sets the state to 2 before calling the next routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AE8E
name: submit_template_copy_to_library
description: Copies a 14-long template into a fixed buffer, clears one long and sets a word to 9, then passes the buffer to a library function.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AEBA
name: stub_self_call_trampoline
description: Contains only a call to itself and a return, with no logic of its own. The code is a stub and not a working routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AEC6
name: reset_buffer_then_dispatch_entry
description: Calls a library function on a fixed buffer and clears a word in it. It then passes five values from a table entry, chosen by the parameter, to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AF40
name: skip_when_library_reports_ready
description: If the slot is in state 2 and a library function returns zero for it, the routine returns early. Otherwise it calls the processing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:AF66
name: load_song_offset_table
description: Opens the file named songs through a library call, reads up to 28 length words to build an offset table into memory, and closes the file. Reading stops early if the table would overflow its size limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B012
name: setup_display_region_if_enabled
description: Returns unless a flag byte is zero. When enabled, it calls a library function with the value 350 and sets up a 320 by 200 region, then makes two more library calls and runs further routines if a check fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B0A0
name: draw_scene_rows_from_tables
description: Loops over 22 rows, using byte tables to pick a step and a height for each row. Rows in the top half draw a backdrop rectangle and a column of strips taken from the first bitmap; the rest are drawn from the second, using library blit calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B364
name: read_space_key_state
description: Calls a library function to read a key code, stores whether it equals the space key code in a flag byte, and returns that result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B386
name: copy_high_buffer_to_block
description: If the source address lies above the 2 MB address limit, allocates a new block through a library call and copies the bytes into it. Otherwise it returns the original pointer unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B3CC
name: project_and_draw_quad
description: Computes the four corner points of a quad from a lookup table, then uses a cross product to decide whether the quad faces the viewer. It draws the quad through several library calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B70E
name: set_state_and_copy_result
description: Sets a word to 2, calls a routine with a fixed record and a table-selected entry, then copies the word into another variable if it is greater than three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B770
name: set_entry_position_and_flags
description: Copies an X value and a Y value plus ten from a table entry chosen by the index. It then writes a byte argument and a flag byte of 1 into the same record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B7B2
name: store_marker_byte_at_slot
description: Selects a record either from a table or from a fixed block, depending on a flag byte. If the byte at offset four of that record is 15 it stores 29 there, otherwise it writes the parameter into the byte at offset five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B7FA
name: store_register_byte_into_slot
description: Selects a record from a table or fixed block as in its sibling routine, then writes the low byte of a data register into the byte at offset five. It takes no parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B828
name: store_byte_at_offset_five
description: Writes a byte value into the record at address register plus five. It has no other logic.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B834
name: populate_random_entry_group
description: If a group is empty and its counter exceeds nine, fills ten six-byte entries with random positions and a random lookup-table value, then marks the group as filled.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B884
name: fill_ten_random_entries
description: Places ten entries at random positions, each with a random lookup-table value and an active flag. It then marks the group as filled and processes pending items up to a count of 19.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:B98E
name: scan_objects_for_region_change
description: Walks a list of object records and computes each one's offset from a reference point. Records of types 3 or 4 within a window around that point cause a region change when their table entry differs from the current one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BA8E
name: step_object_scan_to_next
description: Advances the object record pointer by six bytes and increments the scan counter, then computes the record's offset from the reference point. Records of types 3 or 4 inside the window take the region-matching path, and other records use the general handling path.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BA92
name: claim_slot_for_matching_object
description: For objects inside the window whose type is neither 0 nor 2, takes the next entry in the table. If that entry already matches the object's position it is reused, otherwise it is filled with the object's data and a lookup-table value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BB3E
name: fill_slot_with_object_record
description: Writes a kind value of 4 and a lookup-table value into the next entry, then sets its flag and size from the current index. It raises the maximum counter if needed and copies the object's position into the entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BBAE
name: fill_slot_position_and_advance
description: Sets the entry's kind to 13 and its offset value, then copies the object's position into it. It then moves on to the next object record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BBE8
name: register_object_slot_by_type
description: Takes the next free entry and marks it active with a value from the object's type code. Its priority is 2 for type 6, 0 for type 5 and 1 otherwise, and the object's position is copied into it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BC5A
name: copy_position_with_priority_flag
description: Sets a priority byte to 0 for type 5 objects and 1 otherwise, copies the object's position into the entry, then advances to the next record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BC70
name: copy_position_into_entry_default
description: Sets a priority byte to 1, copies the object's position into the entry, and then advances to the next record for another window check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BCB2
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BCE6
name: read_typed_name_into_buffer
description: Reads keystrokes into a buffer of up to nine printable characters, echoing each one and honouring backspace. Return ends the entry, after which the text is checked against stored entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BD88
name: compare_entered_text_to_word
description: On return, compares the typed buffer with a stored word and returns zero on any mismatch. After a match it clears the matched slot, counts the attempt, and returns one once more than two attempts have been used.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BD98
name: read_entry_until_match
description: Reads a line of keystrokes into a buffer and compares it with stored words on return. It returns zero on mismatch and one once three tries have failed.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BDC8
name: match_word_then_retry_prompt
description: Compares the typed buffer with a stored word and returns zero on mismatch. On a match it clears the slot and counts the attempt, and it returns one after more than two attempts; otherwise it selects the next stored word and reprints the prompt through library calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BDEA
name: compare_typed_text_and_reprompt
description: Compares the typed buffer with a stored word and returns zero on mismatch. A match clears the slot and counts an attempt, and after three attempts it returns one; otherwise it picks the next word and prints the prompt again.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BDEC
name: clear_matched_slot_and_reprompt
description: Clears the slot for the current word, counts the attempt, and returns one once more than two attempts have been made. Otherwise it selects a new stored word and reprints the prompt through library calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BE0C
name: run_library_teardown_sequence
description: Calls a sequence of library functions on the system library base, then repeats a pair of them on a stored library base. It returns no value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BE70
name: store_result_then_release
description: Calls a routine with two arguments and stores its result in a global. If the result is nonzero it passes that result to a second routine, then returns it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BE9E
name: open_df0_device_and_verify
description: Opens the df0: device through a library call and, on success, checks a stored type code against an expected value before passing the handle to another routine. It returns the handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BEFA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The code is only a bad instruction, and the disassembler truncated control flow here. It has no behaviour to describe.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BEFE
name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Polls a flag byte up to 300 times, pausing five ticks through a library call between checks. If the flag is set it clears it and returns one, otherwise it returns zero after the timeout.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BF08
name: poll_flag_five_tick_delay
description: Loops up to 300 times waiting for a flag byte to be set, with a five-tick library delay on each pass. Setting the flag clears it and returns one; reaching the limit returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BF18
name: wait_for_flag_ticks
description: Pauses five ticks per pass for up to 300 passes, waiting for a flag byte to be set. Once set it clears the flag and returns one; on timeout it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BF32
name: open_drive_file_for_letter
description: Builds a path ending in the drive letter given by the parameter, then opens it on the df1: device using one of two modes chosen by a flag. A failed open runs a separate failure routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BF62
name: wait_for_disk_then_open
description: Loops waiting for a disk to be inserted, with two checks that can end the wait. Once the disk is ready it builds a path from the drive letter and opens it in a mode chosen by a flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BF8E
name: prompt_insert_any_disk
description: Shows a Spanish prompt asking for a disk in any drive and waits for one to be inserted. Once a disk is present it opens the drive letter given by the caller, and the abort path shows a cancellation message.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BFAE
name: prompt_and_open_save_file
description: Opens a save file in a mode chosen by a flag. On success it reads several saved structures of fixed sizes into the game's data areas; on failure it returns the error code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BFB0
name: open_save_and_restore_state
description: Opens a drive-letter file and, when the open succeeds, copies saved state blocks of fixed sizes into game data areas. It returns the open result if the file cannot be opened.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:BFDA
name: open_file_and_restore_tables
description: Opens a file and, on success, reads several tables of fixed sizes into the game's data. On failure it returns the open error.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C0BA
name: save_game_with_retry
description: If the file cannot be written, shows a Spanish write-error message and waits for input before retrying. Once writable it writes the saved state records and clears the save-status flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C0DA
name: reset_load_state_after_error
description: Waits for the user to dismiss a load-error message, then, outside the alternate mode, resets several counters and flags. It finishes by calling a library function that refreshes the display.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C108
name: prompt_game_disk_and_reset
description: Loops asking for the game disk until one is seen, then clears several counters and flags unless the alternate mode is active. It refreshes the display through a library call at the end.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C118
name: reset_counters_and_refresh_view
description: Clears a few flags and counters when the alternate mode flag is clear, calls two routines, and then refreshes the display through a library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C228
name: transfer_block_and_flag_failure
description: Transfers a block of data through the open file handle, using a library call when the alternate mode flag is clear and a second routine otherwise. A negative result marks the failure state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C24C
name: read_block_and_flag_error
description: Passes two stack arguments to a library read call on the open handle. A negative result from the call triggers the failure routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C276
name: set_rectangle_around_center
description: Writes a rectangle of four words into an entry chosen by index. The corners sit 250 units left and right of the given X value and 200 units above and below the given Y value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C2D0
name: run_timed_intro_screens
description: Runs an intro sequence: it refreshes the display, shows numbered graphics with timed pauses, and draws a frame region through library calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C3F8
name: prepare_scrolling_title_columns
description: Clears a set of column words, fills two 32-byte buffers from a source table, and sets up a 25-step loop of column offsets. It sets a delay and draws the title bitmap through library calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C4B8
name: animate_title_column_drop
description: Repeatedly randomises two column offsets, copies a 32-byte buffer to the display, and waits a short delay each step. It runs a fixed-length sequence and then pauses for longer at the end.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C4E4
name: finish_title_column_animation
description: Sets two random column offsets and steps the animation by copying a 32-byte buffer and waiting nine ticks. When the step count falls below its limit it waits 30 ticks, restores the base buffer and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C574
name: select_value_from_flag_table
description: Returns 10 when the flag byte at the given table index is nonzero, otherwise returns 8.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C586
name: call_positioned_routine_by_index
description: Chooses an offset from a flag, then passes coordinates derived from a stored position to a routine when the index is below eight. Otherwise it passes fixed coordinates, and it returns the routine's result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C59A
name: call_routine_with_offset_coordinates
description: When the index is below eight, passes stored position values minus fixed offsets, with a count of one, to a routine. Otherwise it passes fixed coordinates, and it returns that routine's result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C5EE
name: call_routine_with_fixed_coordinates
description: Passes three fixed values of 100, a count of one and a buffer address to another routine, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C610
name: apply_entry_action_code
description: Stores a code byte in an entry, and picks a random subtype when the entry's kind is 2. Code 1 calls a routine when a random check passes, while code 8 works out the absolute distance between the entry and a reference position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C630
name: record_code_and_measure_distance
description: Stores a code in an entry and, for code 8, computes absolute horizontal and vertical distances from a reference position before calling a routine. For code 1 it calls a routine when a random test passes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C662
name: measure_entry_distance_by_code
description: For code 8, computes absolute horizontal and vertical distances from the reference position and calls routines based on the results. Other codes are skipped.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C694
name: choose_proximity_action_by_distance
description: For code 8, computes absolute horizontal and vertical distances from the reference position. A random bit then selects one of two routines, with a distance test deciding between them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C740
name: stub_forward_single_call
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other work. It is a thin forwarding stub.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C760
name: apply_action_by_entry_kind
description: Branches on an entry's kind value. Kind 4 sets a three-bit field from a random value and marks the kind as 12, kind 2 sets a status when the position matches a reference, and kinds 3, 5 and 6 call further routines when a test is set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C784
name: apply_actions_later_entry_kinds
description: Handles entry kinds 3, 5, 2, 6 and 10. Kind 2 marks the entry with status 4 when its position matches a reference, kind 10 sets the kind byte to 12, and the other kinds call routines when the trigger value is nonzero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C7B2
name: kind_actions_2_6_10
description: Handles entry kinds 5, 2, 6 and 10. Kinds 2 and 6 call routines and a lookup-based helper when the trigger value is nonzero, and kind 10 sets the kind byte to 12.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C7E0
name: kind_actions_2_and_10
description: Handles entry kinds 2, 6 and 10. Kind 2 may mark the entry with status 4, kind 6 calls a helper with a lookup value, and kind 10 sets the kind byte to 12.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C83A
name: kind_actions_6_and_10
description: Handles entry kinds 6 and 10. Kind 6 runs a helper with a lookup value when the trigger is nonzero, and kind 10 sets the kind byte to 12.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C852
name: call_helper_when_triggered
description: When the trigger value is nonzero, looks up a value from the entry, passes an adjusted version to a helper, and then calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C896
name: set_kind_ten_marker_byte
description: When the entry kind is 10 it calls a routine if the trigger is nonzero, then writes the constant 12 into the entry's kind byte. Other kinds are unaffected.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C8C4
name: decrement_counter_trigger_at_zero
description: Subtracts the given amount from a counter. When the counter goes negative it resets it to zero and calls a routine with the value 13; otherwise it calls a routine with the global argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:C8E6
name: forward_yum_text_message
description: Passes the 'Yum!' text to another routine and returns. It contains no other logic.
